thread:
Jonas (Sales): FYI handing off Meridian Health — trial ends in 3 weeks, renewal looking shaky. Quick context: heavy embedding/semantic search usage, asking for SSO (SAML) and interested in a private deployment eval. During the exec demo they saw intermittent latency spikes (~1–2s extra p95 on multi-turn flows) and that raised concerns. Account health score: 62. Need CS owner, an enablement session for ~10 engineers, and an eng/support triage for the latency + SSO nuances. Customer contact: ryan@meridian.com. Tenant: meridian-987. Procurement timeline: PO expected in ~21 days. Notes: https://redwood.internal/notes/meridian-987 (internal)
Maya (CS): Thanks Jonas — I can pick this up initially. Quick Qs: is the latency reproducible outside the demo? do they require SAML IdP metadata exchanged before we can do a dedicated/private eval? I'll need tenant + any recent traces.
Jonas (Sales): Latency happened during heavy query bursts (embedding + long chat context). I believe it's sporadic but happened on 2 separate demos. They asked that SAML be set up in the test env before next exec call. Tenant is meridian-987. Ryan is primary; CC'd him on the handoff email earlier. I just pasted one of the demo trace ids in the handoff email (trace: TRACE-9f3b). Procurement/PO might slip if we can't show SSO + perf plan.
Aisha (CS): I'll own the onboarding and run the enablement. Proposed plan: 2-week onboarding runway, 2hr technical workshop for their 10-person engineering team, and a runbook for SSO + Dedicated handoff. Can you confirm preferred Tue/Thu mornings? I can start internal tickets once we have logs.
Priya (Support): @Aisha noted — can you drop the last 24h logs and the p95/p99 traces? Example command we use internally:
```
redwoodctl logs --tenant meridian-987 --since 24h --select traces
```
Also need the repro prompt and the model config used in the demo (model name + quantization).
Liam (Eng): tagging in — thanks. From prior incidents similar spikes often correlate with a kernel selection mismatch on quantized long-context runs. If they're on int8 quantized weights and long histories, we should verify model binary and kernel mapping. Please include the model name, seq len used, and any custom tokenizer settings.
Jonas (Sales): Model used was `llama-2-13b-int8` (customer mentioned an int8 quant build). Sample prompt snippet (sanitized): "summarize the last 8 messages and rerank top 5 answers". Demo trace I pasted earlier: TRACE-9f3b. They also ran a parallel embeddings batch job during demo (~1200 vectors/minute).
Priya (Support): Got it. Creating a debug session. Can the customer SRE join? @Jonas please connect us to Ryan's SRE. We'll pull logs and correlate TRACE-9f3b. I'll open a support ticket: CS-7891.
Liam (Eng): If we can get a repro that triggers the spike, I can try a matrix: (int8 vs int4 fallback) x (kv-cache on/off) x seq_len up to 4096. Quick repro snippet for them to run and share results:
```
# run 5 iterations, measure p95
python tools/repro_load.py --tenant meridian-987 --model llama-2-13b-int8 --prompt-file sample_prompts.txt --iters 5
```
Jonas (Sales): I'll request SRE join and share preferred times. Their procurement lead asked for a clear escalation path if SSO setup delays procurement — they want a backup plan to keep the pilot alive.
Aisha (CS): Proposed escalation & mitigation: 1) offer 30-day pilot extension if SSO blocks go past X days, 2) arrange a dedicated eng deep-dive within 48h of confirmed trace reproduction, 3) provide a targeted performance plan (batching/cache/quant profile) and cost estimate for Dedicated. Tagging the renewal risk as HIGH (exec-level concern). :warning:
Maya (CS): Adding the internal escalation path and owners: Aisha -> primary CS, Priya -> support triage, Liam -> eng lead for perf. If SSO vendor integration stalls, CS can provide an interim SAML test harness to demonstrate flow for execs. Also capturing enablement ask: 2hr workshop + walkthrough doc. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Ticket created in internal tracker: CS-7891 — "Meridian: SSO + latency triage" assigned to support oncall.
Aisha (CS): Next steps (internal):
- Aisha: schedule enablement + send pre-work (sample prompts + access checklist)
- Priya: collect logs, correlate TRACE-9f3b, schedule debug call with customer SRE
- Liam: prepare perf repro matrix and run initial tests once logs/repro available
- Jonas: intro email to Ryan + confirm procurement date and SRE availability
- Maya: add 30-day pilot extension clause to playbook for this account
I'll follow up with a calendar invite after Jonas connects Ryan and SRE. Thanks team.
Jonas (Sales): Will intro today and ask Ryan for SRE times. Appreciate the quick pick-up.
Maya (CS): Noted — tagging renewal watch and internal owner. I'll add a health tag + set a 7-day follow-up to check progress.
notes: internal-hand-off; includes tenant id, demo trace id, ticket CS-7891, renewal risk HIGH, enablement ask (2hr workshop), pilot extension mitigation
